comment: 38yo female, germline PALB2 truncating loss-of-function variant confirmed on multi-gene HBOC panel after maternal sister diagnosed with breast cancer at age 45 (PALB2-positive on tumor testing). No personal cancer. PALB2 carriers approach BRCA2 breast-cancer penetrance (lifetime ~33-58% per Yang JCO 2020), modest PDAC + ovarian signals. Fires RF-PALB2-CONFIRMED-CARRIER (relevant_diseases: breast, PDAC, ovarian). Engine routes to PreventionPlan: default = IND-PALB2-CARRIER-PREVENTION-SURVEILLANCE (BRCA-style: annual breast MRI + mammography from age 30; pancreatic surveillance EUS/MRI alternating from age 50 or 10y before earliest family PDAC in FDR-of-PDAC carriers per CAPS 2022); alternative = IND-PALB2-CARRIER-PREVENTION-OBSERVATION (cascade testing + general-population schedule, declining BRCA-style intensified track).
